title: Existence of factorization through a restricted formal kernel
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal, $U$ an open subscheme with its Noetherian instance, and $R$ the restriction functor of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-restriction-objects]. Let $F,G$ belong to the formal module category of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], let $\alpha:F\to G$, and let $c$ be any limiting kernel fork of $\alpha$. For any $T\in\mathrm{Coh}(U,I|_U)$ and $\gamma:T\to R(F)$ with $R(\alpha)\circ\gamma=0$, there exists $\delta:T\to R(c.\mathrm{pt})$ with $R(c.\iota)\circ\delta=\gamma$. No uniqueness, cokernel preservation, or finite product preservation is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the stabilized image system S, formal module K, quotient isomorphisms and arrow iota from coherentFormalModule_kernel. Keep its zero-composite equation; the global uniqueness clause is not needed. At the end the given limiting fork supplies a lift k:K -> c.pt with k followed by c.iota equal to iota.

proof.text: Coherence of the levels implies quasi-coherence. Kernels and cokernels of quasi-coherent modules are quasi-coherent, so hS identifies every S_m with a quasi-coherent abelian image. Restriction preserves kernels and cokernels, hence abelian images. Compose these comparison isomorphisms with the comparison of the restricted levelwise kernel; precomposition by an isomorphism does not change its image. Reuse the proved private restrictionQuotientIso and restrictionQuotientIso_π helpers from TorsionControlledFormalRestriction through a proof-only import all. Only these generic quotient/restriction comparisons are used, not the torsion-controlled theorem. Their proof compares recursive ideal-power product images with ideal-data powers and applies the ideal-product restriction formula, then identifies cokernels with their projection equations. Compose the quotient comparison with the restricted e_n. Applying restriction to htrans and hcomp, and rewriting the projection equations, proves the corresponding equations on U.

proof.text: Apply coherentFormalModule_kernel_factorization on U to the restricted image system, restricted iota and quotient isomorphisms from the preceding step. This gives delta:T -> R(K) and delta followed by R(iota) equal to gamma. Compose delta with R(k), where k is the lift into the given limiting kernel fork from step 1. Functoriality and associativity give the required factorization through R(c.iota). No extension of T or termwise monicity is used.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModules_restriction_kernel_factorization {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.Opens)
    [IsNoetherian U.toScheme] {F G : CoherentFormalModule X I} (α : F ⟶ G)
    (c : KernelFork α) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (T : CoherentFormalModule U.toScheme (I.comap U.ι))
    (γ : T ⟶ (coherentFormalModulesRestriction I U).obj F)
    (hγ : γ ≫ (coherentFormalModulesRestriction I U).map α = 0) :
    ∃ δ : T ⟶ (coherentFormalModulesRestriction I U).obj c.pt,
      δ ≫ (coherentFormalModulesRestriction I U).map c.ι = γ
